questions.notes: Only vote-intention table in the PDF; presented as the current party map (no scenario framing), so treated as main. Pct column is labelled 'אחוז גולמי' (gross/raw share) with footnote: does not account for allocation of undecideds or Bader-Ofer calculations; seats are the final allocation. Two rows are combined lists as they run in this poll: 'הציונות הדתית וזהות' (mapped to הציונות הדתית) and 'חד"ש-תע"ל, רע"ם ובל"ד' (Joint List incl. Ra'am, mapped to הרשימה המשותפת). Below-threshold parties (second table, 3.25% threshold) recorded with seats=0. Passing parties' pct sums to 92.4 (as printed), below-threshold 5.7, total 98.1 - remaining ~1.9% not explained (no undecided/other row). Blocs: Netanyahu bloc 63, opposition 57.

extraction_notes: All 4 pages readable. Page 1: survey details. Page 2: seat map + below-threshold table. Pages 3-4: PM suitability and 7 issue questions (not extracted). Fieldwork 3.9.2026, 11:30-15:30. Initial sample taken as 'גודל המדגם ההתחלתי' = 868 (7,024 were invited; 6,156 refused/unqualified; non-participation 87.6%). Respondents = 789. Method: 'איסוף דיגיטלי אינטרנטי' -> internet. Footer says data weighted, percentages rounded.
